text.body: śrautapadārthanirvacanam | indro mahendro vā devatātvena vihitaḥ tatra satyapi puroḍāśadravye adhikaṃ dravyadvayaṃ vihitaṃ tatraikaṃ payaḥ dvitīyaṃ dadhi tadetad dvayaṃ homārthaṃ samyag nayatīti kartṛtyutpattyā tādṛśo yajamānaḥ sannayannityabhidhīyate | dadhipayasī ca pāyasānnāyyeti sūtreṇa nipātanāt karmavyutpattyā sānnāyyapadābhidheye || sānāyyadadhipayasoḥ saṃpādane gavāṃ saṃkhyā aśaktatvāt nyūnā kriyate cet ṣaṭtvasaṃkhyāto nyūnā na kāryā ṣaḍbhyo gobhyo nyanasaṃkhyākā gāvo na kartavyāḥ tato 'dhikāścediṣṭāpattireva | pūrvamāhūtayā śākhayā etāsāṃ gavāṃ vatsānāṃ dūrīkaraṇaṃ samantrakaṃ vatsāpākaraṇamityucyate | tatastasyāḥ śākhāyāḥ parṇāni chittvā yaṃ mūlabhāgaṃ prādeśamātraṃ chittvā dhṛṣṭyākāraṃ karoti sonnāyyasaṃskārakāle gārhapatyāṅgārāṇāmudagdiśi nirūhaṇādau upayogī sa upaveṣa iti gīyate || agrabhāgastu tribhirdarbhaveṇyākāraṇa nibaddhaḥ śākhāpavitrapadavācyastasya sāyaṃdohādāvupayogaḥ || asannayatastu yajamānasya śākhāharaṇābhāvāt vratopāyanānantaraṃ adhvaryuḥ gārhapatyasyottarato vidyamānamasidaṃ śvaparaśuṃ vādatte mantreṇa | lohamayakṣuraḥ chedanopayogī asida ityucyate || evaṃ barhiśchedanādyupayogī śvasadṛśaḥ kuṭhāraḥ śvaparaśurityucyate || tayoranyatarad gṛhītvā mantreṇāhavanīyadeśaṃ gatvā mantreṇa vedimavekṣya darbhadeśaṃ gatvā prastaraparyāptaṃ darbhamuṣṭiṃ parigrahṇāti asidādinā chedanīyadarbhamuṣṭeḥ āsamantāt bhedāya bhrāmaṇaṃ parigrahaṇapadavācyam || chinne darbhamuṣṭau bhūmau yo mūlabhāgo dṛśyate sa chedanakriyāyā ādhāratvāt adhikaraṇe lyuṭā chedanapadavācyaḥ | chedane bhedane caiva khanane pitṛrakṣasoḥ| raudrābhicāraṇīyeṣu udakasyābhimantraṇamiti vacanāt chedanabhedanakhananapaitṛkarākṣasaraudrābhicāraṇakarmasu kṛteṣu śuddhyarthaṃ vihitaṃ dakṣiṇakarasya jalena prakṣālanaṃ udakopasparśanamucyate | tatra prakṛtīṣṭau catasro darbhamuṣṭayaśchidyante prathamā darbhamuṣṭirmantraiḥ saṃskṛtā vedyāṃ juhūryasyānnidhīyate vidhṛtisaṃjñakayoḥ udagagrayordarbhayorupari yā ca prāgagrā sthāpitā bhavati sā prastara ityucyate | anyāstisra amantrakasakalakriyāmātrasādhyāḥ vedyāstaraṇārthāḥ haviṣāṃ pātrāṇāṃ sthāpanayogyā barhiḥpadavācyāḥ || darbhatrayaṃ gṛhītvā pradakṣiṇamāveṣṭya agrabhāge anyaddarbhatrayaṃ mūlena saṃyojya veṣṭanena grathitamiva kṛtvā tadapi tathaivāveṣy tadagrabhāge anyaddarbhatrayaṃ tathaivaṃ kṛtvā punastadagrabhāge tathā karoti evaṃ kṛte sandhitrayaṃ madhye saṃpadyate taddarbhasūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā ante granthiḥ kāryaḥ anena barhirbadhyate ata etad barhiḥsaṃnahanaṃ nāma śulbanāmakam || evamidhmabandhanārthaṃ idhmasaṃnahanaṃ nāma śulbanāmakam | barhiḥ saṃbharaṇānantaraṃ adhvaryuridhmadeśaṃ gatvā asidena śvaparaśunā vā idhmaṃ chinatti tūṣṇīṃ tasminnekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāni kāṣṭhāni bhavanti tatra tritayaṃ kāṣṭhānāmāhavanīyasya paścād dakṣiṇata uttarataśca prathamamekhalāyā upari sthāpanārthaṃ mekhalāpāramitāyāmaṃ parita āhavanīyasya nidhānāta purastātsūryasya manasā paridhitvakalpanātparidhisaṃjñakaṃ bhavati | anyāni kāṣṭhāni prādeśamātrāṇi tatra pañcadaśasāmidhenyarthāni ekamanuyājārthaṃ dve āhavanīyāyatanasyāntarūrdhvāgre dakṣiṇottarayorbhāgayo ropaṇārthe etānyaṣṭādaśa kāṣṭhāni samitpadavācyāni || kvacidvikṛtīṣṭyādiṣu adhikā api samidhaḥ sāmidhenīvṛddhā gṛhyante evamekaviṃśatidārukaḥ saṃgha idhmapadavācyaḥ | idhmasya chedanakāle yāni kāṣṭhaśakalāni itastataḥ patanti tāni karaṇavyutpattyā idhmapravraścanapadenābhidhīyante || caturṇāmapyṛtvijāṃ bhojane paryāptaḥ dakṣiṇāgnau suśṛta odanaḥ anu paścāt yāgānantaramṛtvigbhojanārthamāhriyate iti karmavyutpatyā anvāhāryapadavācyaḥ || anvāhārya odano yasyāṃ sthālyāṃ śrapyate sā anvāhāryasthālītyucyate || madantīnāmikā āpo yasminpātre saṃtāpyante tatpātramapi madantīpadena vyavahriyate || puroḍāśacarusaṃbandhivrīhyādīn ulūkhale musalenāvahṛtya yava śūrpeṇa nistuṣakaraṇarūpaṃ phalīkaraṇaṃ karoti tatra ye tuṣādayaḥ patanti te karaṇavyutpattyā phalīkaraṇapadavācyāḥ | teṣāṃ yāgānantaraṃ dakṣiṇāgnau juhvā caturgṛhītenājyena saha homo vihitaḥ ataḥ yāgasamāptiparyantaṃ teṣāṃ sthāpanāya nirmitaṃ aśvatthamayaṃ pātraṃ phalīkaraṇapātramityucyate || yadā gārhapatye adhvaryuḥ patnīsaṃyājaiḥ pracarati tadā devānāṃ patnīyāgakāle strīyahavirbhāgagrahaṇārthamāgatānāṃ devānāṃ patnīnāṃ strītvāllajjayā tirodhānāya aśvattha kāṣṭhanirmitaṃ tirodhānakaraṇayogyaṃ kaṭākāratvāt antardhānakaṭamityucyate || adhvaryustīrthapraveśānantaraṃ gārhapatyasyottarata upaviśya iḍājapaṃ kṛtvā devā gātuvid ityṛcaṃ japati tasyāmṛci yato vātaśabdo vartate śrutau vātaśabdena yāgārambhasamāptayorvarṇanāt iḍā devahūriti yajurmantrajapa iḍājapapadenocyate || tata āhavanīyasyotaratastiṣṭhan hastau mantreṇa saṃmṛśate etatkarma pāṇyoḥ sāvadhānatvāya kariṣyamāṇakarmasupreraṇārūpaṃ pāṇisaṃmarśanamityucyate || tata āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnigārhapatyān krameṇa darbhaiḥ paristṛṇāti agneḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdarbhaiḥ prācyādiṣu paristṛtiriti vacanāta prācyāṃ prathamamekhalopari caturbhidarbhaistathaiva dakṣiṇasyāṃ pratīcyāmudīcyāṃ ca krameṇa staraṇaṃ paristaraṇapadārthaḥ || tato gārhapatyasya purastād vedyāṃ paribhojanīyadarbhānāstīrya teṣu dvandvaṃ nyañci prakṣālitāni yajñapātrāṇi prāksaṃsthānyudagapavargāṇi sthāpayati tadetatkarma pātrāsādanapadārthaḥ || tato brahmaṇi svāyatane upaviṣṭe yajamānena ca samantrakadvitīyavaraṇena vṛte paribhojanīyadarbhaḥ saṃtatāṃ pṛṣṭyāṃ gārhapatyamadhyādārabhyāhavanīyamadhyaparyantaṃ stṛṇāti mantreṇa etat karma pṛṣṭyāstaraṇamityucyate || adhvaryuḥ prayājairiṣṭvā udaṅṅutyākramya juhūsthnājyaśeṣeṇa dhruvāmabhighārya krameṇa havīṃṣyabhighārya upabhṛtamabhighārayati tadetatprayājaśeṣābhighāraṇamucyate | adhvaryuḥ dhruvājyāt sruveṇa juhvāṃ ekavāramājyaṃ gṛhītvā anuvākyāpaṭhanārthaṃ hotāraṃ anubrūhītyantena mantreṇa saṃpreṣya pustrivāraṃ gṛhṇāti tadetat caturavattamityucyate|| yasyaiva bhavati sa yajamānaścaturavattī bhavati | jāmadagnyā vatsavidāvārṣṭiṣeṇāstathaiva ca| bhārgavāścyāvanā aurvāḥ pañcāvattina īritā iti vacanāt etadvacanoktagotrāṇāṃ yajamānānāṃ pañcavāramavadyati etatpañcāvattamityucyate || yajamānaśca pañcāvattī bhavati | do avakhaṇḍane iti paṭhitatvāt sthāpitahaviṣaḥ homaparimitasya bhāgasya grahaṇārthaṃ khaṇḍanaṃ avadānamityucyate || anayā rītyā avadāya gṛhītvā atyākramya dakṣiṇābhimukhyā srucā āhavanīyasyaiśānabhāge āgneyamājyabhāgaṃ hutvā udaṅṅutyākramya pūrvavadavadāya gṛhītvā atyākramya udaṅmukhyā srucā āgneyadeśe saumyamājyabhāgaṃ juhoti tatra ājyaṃ bhāgo yayoriti vyutpattyā taddevate agnīṣomau ājyabhāgapadārthau | ājyabhāgānantaraṃ juhvāmupastīrya mantreṇa dakṣiṇahastanamaskāreṇa puroḍāśādirūpaṃ havirupasthāya upaviśya mantreṇa havirabhimṛśya pañcabhiraṅgulibhiḥ aṅguṣṭhamadhyamānāmikābhirvā prathamapuroḍāśādeḥ pūrvārdhāt avadāya carvāvidravyasya tu mekṣaṇenaivāvadāya dvitīyaṃ paścārdhādavadāya pañcāvattinastu madhyātpūrvārdhātpaścārdhāditi triravadāya abhighārayati evaṃ rītyā kriyamāṇaṃ carupuroḍāśādyavadānamucyate | avattaṃ havirabhighārya ājyasthālyājyena mantreṇa avadānasthānānyāpyāyati tadetat pratyañjanamityucyate || evaṃ rītyā avadāya atyākramya vaṣaṭkṛte prāksaṃsthā udaksaṃsthā vā pradhānāhutīrju hoti so'yaṃ pradhānayāga ityucyate || pradhānayāge avadānānantaraṃ atyākramaṇātpūrvaṃ dhrauvājyena sruveṇa tūṣṇīṃ kariṣyamāṇatattatpradhānahomadeśe sviṣṭakṛddhomadeśe ca ekāmāhutiṃ juhoti sā purastādāhutirityucyate || evaṃ pratyākramaṇānantaraṃ prakṣiptasya haviṣa upari anyāmāhutiṃ juhoti sā upariṣṭādāhutirityucyate || pradhānahomānantaraṃ upastīrya sarveṣāṃ haviṣāṃ uttarārdhāt sakṛtsakṛdavadānaṃ pañcāvattinastu dviravadānaṃ bhavati evaṃ tato dvirabhighārayati avatte sviṣṭakṛti sruveṇa darśe amāvāsyādevatākāṃ paurṇamāse paurṇamāsīdevatākāmāhutiṃ juhoti sa pārvaṇahoma ityucyate || atra puroḍāśāderupasthānābhimarśane na bhavataḥ avadānadeśānāṃ pratyañjanaṃ ca na bhavati evamavadāya atyākramya vaṣaṭśate agnau aiśānadeśe juhoti so'yaṃ sviṣṭakṛddhoma ityucyate || hotā ājyabhāgaprabhṛti sviṣṭakṛtparyantaṃ yājyāpāṭhe āguraṃ uccārya saṃhitayā dvitīyāntaṃ devatānāma uccārya yājyāṃ saṃhitayā pati tadetat devatānāmoccāraṇaṃ devatādeśa ityucyate || sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajeti śrutvā āguramuccārya devatāmādiśya nigadaṃ paṭhitvā yājyāsaṃjñāmṛcaṃ paṭhati sa sviṣṭakṛnnigada ityucyate || adhvaryuḥ sviṣṭakṛddhomānantaraṃ pratyākramya upariṣṭādāhutiṃ hutvā juhvāṃ jalaṃ gṛhītvā saṃkṣālya tatjalaṃ madhyaparidherantardeśe mantreṇa udaksaṃsthaṃ prakṣipati tat antaḥ paridhininayamityucyate || punarjuhūṃ jalena prakṣālya vahnau niṣṭapya pūrayitvā mantreṇa paridherbahiḥ jalaṃ pūrvavat prakṣipati tat bahiḥparidhininayanamityucyate | tata upabhṛti vidyamānamājyaṃ juhvāṃ kṛtvā yathāyatanaṃ juhūpabhṛtau sādayitvā mantreṇa prāśitraharaṇe prathamapradhānadravyasaṃbandhinaṃ prāśitramavadyati sruvadaṇḍenābhighārya praṇītānāṃ paścimataḥ sādayati sa bhāgaḥ prāśituḥ bahmaṇa: ayamiti vigraheṇa prāśitrapadavācyaḥ | tata iḍāpātraṃ vedyāṃ udagagraṃ nidhāya tasmin yāvanti pradhānadravyāṇi tāvadarthaṃ sakṛdeva udakasaṃsthaṃ ājyasthālyājyenopastīrya pratha śrītapadārthanirvacanam | śati | virāḍasi sapatnahā samrāḍasi bhrātṛvyahā svarāḍasyabhimātihā viśvarāḍasi viśvāsānnāṣṭrāṇāhantā | iti | sarvatramantrāvṛttiḥ| krameṇoparavān prokṣati| rakṣohaṇo valagahanaḥ prokṣāmi vaiṣṇavān | iti | mantrāvṛttyā, sarvān prokṣati | rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'vanayāti vaiṣṇavān | iti | tathaiva sarveṣvapo 'vaninayati yavosi yavayāsmaddveṣo yavayārātīḥ | iti krameṇa sarveṣu yavān praskandayati | rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'vastṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavān | iti sarveṣūparaveṣu barhiṣā 'vastṛṇāni | rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'bhijuhoti| vaiṣṇavān svāhā | iti sarveṣūparaveṣu hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya tadupari krameṇa sruvāhutyā abhijuhoti | vaiṣṇavebhya uparavebhya idamiti yajamānaḥ | ayamuparavasaṃskāra ityucyate || pratyekaṃ sārdhaprādeśavistāre prādeśatrayadīrghe milite samacaturasre adhiṣavaṇaphalake ādāya | rakṣohaṇau valagahanāvupadadhāmi vaiṣṇavī iti saṃsṛṣṭe phalake teṣāmuparavāṇāmupari dadhāti | tayoranavasarpaṇāya dvābhyāṃ śaṅkubhyāṃ purastātpariṇihanti | dvābhyāṃ paścāt | dvābhyāmabhitaḥ| evaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ śaṅkubhiḥ pariṇihatya | rakṣohaṇau valagahanau paryūhāmi vaiṣṇavī | pradakṣiṇaṃ purīṣeṇa paryūhati rakṣohaṇau valagahanau paristṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavī | iti tayorupari barhiṣā 'vastṛṇāti | rakṣohaṇau balagahanau vaiṣṇavī | ityabhimṛśati | etāvatkarma uparaveṣu phalakapratiṣṭhāpanamucyate || tato yajñapratiṣṭheti mantreṇa tūṣṇīṃ vā phalakayorānaḍuhaṃ carmāstīrya tiraścarman phalake grāvaṇodvādayati | bṛhannasi bṛhadgrāvā bṛhatīmindrāya vācaṃ vada | iti | nīḍe carmotsādayati | grāvasugrāvāṇam | dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyāgre śrautapadārthanirvacanam | stotropākaraṇāya barhirmuṣṭīn badhnāti | tataḥ ehi yajamāneti yajamānamāmantrya āgnīdhrīyamadhye sphyenoddhṛtyāvokṣya tatra cātvālapurīṣasikatā nyupya aratnimātraṃ parimaṇḍale kharaṃ karoti | vibhūrasi pravāhaṇo raudreṇānīkena pāhi māgne pipṛhi māmāhisīḥ | etanmantrapāṭhastūbhayoradhvaryuyajamānayoḥ | etadāgnīdhrīyakhara karaṇamucyate || antaḥ sadasaṃ prāk padadvayamavaśeṣya pṛṣṭhyāyāntathaiva hotuḥ kharaṃ karoti | vahnirasi havyavāhano raudreṇāhisīḥ iti | ayaṃ hotṛkharo hotṛdhiṣṇyamityucyate || agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya hotṛdhiṣṇyāddakṣiṇato 'ratnimātre maitrāvaruṇasya kharaṃ karoti | śvātrosi pracetā raudreṇāsoḥ | iti ayaṃ kharo maitrāvaruṇadhiṣṇyamityucyate || tasya dhiṣṇayasyottarato 'ratnimātre brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ | tutho'si viśvāvedā raudreṇāsīḥ | ayaṃ kharo brāhmaṇācchaṃsidhiṣṇyamityucyate || tasyottarato 'ratnimātre potuḥ kharaṃ karoti | uśigasi kavī raudreṇāsīḥ | iti | ayaṃ kharaḥ potṛkhara ityucyate || taduttarato 'ratnimātra neṣṭu: kharaṃ karoti | aṅghārirasi bambhārī raudreṇāsīḥ | iti | ayaṃ kharo neṣṭudhiṣṇyamityucyate || taduttarato 'ratnimātre acchāvākasya| avasyūrasi duvasvān raudreṇāsīḥ | iti ayaṃ kharo 'cchāvākadhiṣṇyamityucyate || āgnīdhrīyavanmārjālīye kharaṃ karoti | śundhyūrasi śrautapadārthanirvacanam | mārjālīyo raudreṇāsīḥ | iti ayaṃ kharo mārjālīyadhiṣṇyamityucyate || avaśiṣṭacātvālapurīṣasikatā āgnīdhrīye tūṣṇīṃ nivapati | tato 'dhvaryurauttaravedikamagnimupatiṣṭhate | samrāḍasi kṛśānū raudreṇāsīḥ | iti | tata āstāvamupatiṣṭhate | pariṣadyo 'si pavamāno raudreṇāsīḥ | iti | tataścātvālam pratakvā 'si nabhasvān raudreṇāsīḥ| iti | paśuśrapaṇamagniṃ tata upatiṣṭhate | asammṛṣṭo 'si havyasūdo raudreṇāsīḥ | iti | sadasaḥ paścimadvāre tiṣṭhan audumbarīmupatiṣṭhate | ṛtadhāmā 'si suvarjyotī raudreṇāsīḥ| iti | tato brahmasadanamupatiṣṭhate | brahmajyotirasi suvardhāmā raudreṇāsīḥ | iti | tatrastha eva śālāmukhīyam | 'ajosyekapādraudreṇāsīḥ | iti | tato gārhapatyam | ahirasi budhniyo raudreṇāsīḥ | iti| idaṃ auttaravedikādyupasthānamityucyate | itaḥ prabhṛtyadhvaryuḥ pratyak sado nātīyāt | tatrastha eva sampreṣyati | stṛṇata barhiḥ prabrataṃ yacchata samapivratāhvayadhvamāstāvaṃ bahulaṃ stṛṇītonnetargrāvṇo vāyavyāni droṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāya patnīśāle patnīṃsaṃsādayāgnīdājyamadhiśraya pratiprasthātaḥ srucaḥ sammṛḍḍhyājyenodehi pṛṣadājyāya dadhyā''hara | iti | ayaṃ praiṣo mahāvedyāṃ barhirāsādanādipraiṣa ityucyate || dakṣiṇe vedyante mahābarhiṣo muṣṭiṃ stṛṇāti deva barhirūrṇāmradasantveti prākṛtamantreṇa | mahāvediṃ bahulāṃ purastātpratīcīṃ stṛṇāti | tūṣṇīmardhastanavrataṃ pradadāti | unnetā pañca grāvṇaḥ saptadaśa vāyavyāni prādeśamātrāṇi ulūkhalākārāṇi ekatomukhāni daśa camasān pariplupātraṃ ada śrautapadārthanirvacanam | rahaṃ srugākāraṃ droṇakalaśaṃ daśāpavitre catasraḥ sthālī: upagrahādi yadanyadupayuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ prakṣālya droṇakalaśe daśāpavitre vinyasya etatsarvaṃ prāgvaṃśe sādayati| vāyavyānāṃ madhye audumbaraṃ catuḥsrakti yattaddadhigrahapātramucyate | rāsnācihnitaṃ pātramaindravāyamityucyate | pilakācihnitaṃ maitrāvaruṇamityucyate dvikoṇaṃ pātramāśvinamityucyate| bailvaṃ pātraṃ śukrapātramityucyate | vaikaṅkataṃ ślakṣṇaṃ manthipātramityucyate | audumbaraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ adābhyasaṃjñakam || nyagrodhakāṣṭhanirmitāni atigrāhyāṇītyucyante | ubhayatomukhe dve pātre ṛtupātrasañjñake | itarāṇi pātrāṇi naiyagrodhānyaudumbarāṇi vā bhavanti | camasā naiyagrodhāḥ| caturasro 'lpadavaṇḍo brahmacamasa ityucyate| maṇḍalākāraḥ sa daṇḍo hotṛcamasa ucyate | vistīrṇāgraḥ sa daṇḍo yajamānacamaso bhavati || trikoṇaḥ sa daṇḍa udgātṛcamasapadavācyaḥ| adhobhāge vakraḥ sa daṇḍaḥ praśāstṛcamasa ucyate | upari vakra: sa daṇḍo brāhmaṇācchaṃsicamaso bhavati| tathaiva rāsnāyuktaḥ sa, daraḍo 'cchāvākacamaso bhavati| tīkṣaṇāgraḥ sa daṇḍa āgnīdhracamaso bhavati | adhvaryuḥ agnīṣomīyapaśuśākhāyā: paśuvatpavitraṃ karoti | tataḥ paśukumbhī śākhāpavitraṃ vapāśrapaṇyau raśane śūlaṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍaṃ, śālāmukhīyasyottarato darbheṣu sādayati | śrautapadārthanirvacanam | śundhadhvamiti prākṛtamantreṇa prokṣati | āgnīdhraḥ pāṇī sammṛśyāgnīn prajvālya paristīrya śālāmukhīyasyāgre darbhān saṃstīrya teṣu sphyamagnihotrahavaṇīṃ juhūmityādi paśuvatpātrāṇyāsādya gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpayati pratiprasthātā pāṇisammarśanaṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇata upaveśya śālāmukhīyādārabhyottaravediparyantaṃ pṛṣṭhyāṃ stīrtvā pavitre kṛtvā yajamāna vācaṃ yaccheti yajamānaṃ sampreṣyāgnihotrahavaṇīṃ prākṛtamantreṇādāya tathaiva pratitapya prokṣaṇīsaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā pātrāṇi prākṛtamantreṇa prokṣya ājyaṃ dadhi ca tathaiva nirupya adhiśrityobhayaṃ paryagni karoti |tato 'dhvaryuḥ pāṇī sammṛśya mantreṇa prākṛtena sphyādānādi kṛtvā kharadeśe sphyaṃ stabdhvā sampraiṣamāha | prokṣaṇīrāsādayetyādi paśuvat | āgnīdhraḥ prokṣaṇī: sādayati | adhvaryuḥ sphyaṃ prakṛtivaddadāti | pratiprasthātottaravedisamīpe idhmābarhiṣī upasādayati | āgnīdhraḥ dakṣiṇena sruvaṃ racādhitiṃ savyena hastena vedāgrāṇyādāya śālāmukhīye agnervāmiti mantreṇa pratitapya sruvamantreṇaivobhayaṃ sammṛjya pratiprasthātre prayacchati| pratiprasthātā juhvādīn paśuvatpratitapya sammṛjya vedāgrāṇi śālāmukhīye prakṣipya pātrāṇi agreṇotkaraṃ tṛṇeṣu sādayitvā punarādāya śālāmukhīyasakāśe nidadhāti | patnī śālāmukhīyamājyaṃ cāvekṣa yitvā yajamānamājyamavekṣayati | adhvaryuḥ prokṣaṇīnāmuttarata ānīyājyaṃ svayamavekṣyotpūya prokṣaṇīścotpūyājyaṃ dadhi cādāya brahmayajamānābhyāṃ saha prāgvaṃśaṃ gatvā vedyāṃ srukṣu paśuvadājyāni gṛhītvā parikarmibhyaḥ pradāyā'pa upaspṛśya brahmaṇe somaṃ rājānaṃ dadāti | brahmā rājānamādāya śālāmukhīyamagreṇa pariśrityottarato vasthāyānvagagniṃ nayati | śrautapadārthanirvacanam | adhvaryuḥ śālāmukhīye praṇayanīyamidhmamādhāya cātvālādupayamanīḥ kalpayitvā purāṇagārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya adhvaryu yajamānastaṃ patnī tāṃ putrāḥ tān pautrāstān jñātayaśceti jyeṣṭhānukrameṇa samanvārabdheṣu satsu pracaraṇyāṃ' caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā śālāmukhīye juhoti | tyaṃ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dvaṣobhyonyakṛtebhya , uruyantāsi varūthaṃ svāhā iti | somāyedamiti yajamānaḥ | tataḥ sruveṇa juhoti | juṣāṇa apturājyasyā vetu svāhā | iti | agnaya idamiti yajamānaḥ | punaścaturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā samapraiṣamāha | agnīṣomābhyāṃ praṇīyamānābhyāmanubrūhi | iti | ayamagnīṣomapraṇayanapraiṣa ucyate || hotrā prathamāyāmṛci triruktāyāmidhmaṃ śālāmukhīyādudyamya pūrvayā dvāropaniṣkāmanti | anvagrājñā cājyaiścānvak grāvṇo vāyavyāni | ayaṃ no agnirvarivaḥ kṛṇotvayaṃ mṛdhaḥ pura etu prabhindan | ayaṃ śatrūn jayatu jarhṛṣāṇo 'yaṃ vājaṃ jayatu vājasātau | itimantreṇa | tataḥ uttareṇa sadaḥ parītyāgnīdhrāgāre agniṃ nidhāya paristīrya pariṣicya caturgṛhītenābhijuhoti | agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhānte nama uktiṃ vidhema svāhā | iti | agnaya idamiti yajamānaḥ | atraivaitat grāvṇo vāyavyāni sādayitvā uttareṇāgnīdhrīya dhiṣṇyaṃ rājñā cānyaiśca gatvā | āhavanīye sruvāhutiṃ juhoti | uruviṣṇovikramasvasvāhā | iti viṣṇava idamiti yajamānaḥ | brahmā rājānamanyasmai pradāya mantreṇopaviśati | yajamānaśca svāyatane | adhvaryuḥ prokṣaṇīrunmadhyannityādi yanme agna ityantaṃ paśuṣatkaroti | khare prokṣaṇādīni karoti | śrautapadārthanirvacanam | mahāvediśroṇyāṃ prokṣaṇīrninayati | brahmāyathāgatamāgatya rājānamupādatta | yajamāna: api upaspṛśya yathetametya brahmaṇaḥ sakāśādrājānamādāya pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādayati | somo jigātu gātuviddevānāmeti niṣkṛtamṛtasya yonimāsadam | iti | adhvaryuḥ apa upaspṛśya dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya nīḍe kṛṣṇājinamāstṛṇāti | adityāḥ sado 'si | iti | yajamānastasmin kaṣṇājine rājānaṃ sādayati | adityāḥ sada āsīda | iti | eṣa vo deva savitaḥ somastaṃ rakṣadhvaṃ mā vo 'dabhan | iti rājānaṃ devatābhyaḥ, prayacchati | etattvaṃ deva soma devo devānupāgā idamahaṃ manuṣyo manuṣyān saha prajayā saha rāyaspoṣeṇa | iti taṃ somamupatiṣṭhate | namo devabhyaḥ iti samasyopari prāñcamañjaliṃ karoti | svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ iti tasya dakṣiṇato nyañcamañjalim | apa upaspṛśya | idamahaṃ nirvaruṇasya pāśāt | iti tato niṣkramya | suvarabhivikhyeṣaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ jyotiḥ | ityāhavanīyamupatiṣṭhate | adhvaryuḥ | avāntaradīkṣāṃ visṛja | iti preṣyati | tato yajamānaḥ | agne vratapate tvaṃ vratānāṃ vratapatirasi yā mama tanūstvayyabhūdiyaṃ sā mayi yā tava tanūrmayyabhūdeṣā sā tvayi yathāyathaṃ nau vratapate vratinorvratāni | ityāhavanīyamupatiṣṭhate | adhvaryuḥ | srastrīṣvamekhalāṃ pramuṣṭīn sāraya yajamāna iti tvācakṣatāṃ nāmagrāhaṃ te pitṛbhiḥ pitāmahaiḥ prapitāmahaiḥ putraiḥ pautraiḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyāmāhvayatu | iti sampreṣyati | vapāyāgānte subrahmaṇyaḥ pitā putrīyāhvānaṃ karoti | yūpāvaṭāntamidānīmeva vā karoti| tato yācati yavamatīrityādi yūpaprakṣālanādi vapāmārjanāntaṃ paśuvat | prakṛtau nirūḍhapaśau yatrendrāgnipadaṃ śrautapadārthanirvacanam | tatrāgnīṣomapadasyohaḥ kāryaṃ iti viśeṣaḥ | āhūtāyāṃ pitāputrīyāyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ kumbhamādāyāntareṇa cātvālātkarāvudaṅ upaniṣkramya srotobhimukhaṃ sthitvā chāyātapasoḥ sandhau vasatīvarīsaṃjñā apo gṛhṇāti | haviṣmatīrimā āpo haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmāṃ āvivāsati haviṣmāṃ astu sūryaḥ | iti | sūrye tvastaṅgate hiraṇyamantardhāya gṛhṇāti | ātapacchāyāyāṃ svadehacchāyāyāṃ vṛkṣacchāyāyāṃ vā gṛhṇāti | idaṃ vasatīvarīgrahaṇamityucyate || tataḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya vasatīvarīkumbhaṃ savye nidhāyāntareṇa cātvālotkarāvuttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ sadaśca gatvā pūrvayādvārā śālāṃ prapādya śālāmukhīyasya paścātsaṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | agnervopannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi sumnāya sumninīḥ sumne mā dhatta | iti etadvasatīvarīsādanamucyate | tato 'gnīnpuroḍāśamityādi svaruhomavarjamājyeḍāntaṃ paśuvat | aupayājā'ṅgāraharaṇamāgnīdhrīyāditi viśeṣaḥ | vṛtrahābhūyāsamiti puroḍāśayāge yajamānasyānumantraṇam | indriyāvī bhūyāsamityaṅgayāge| ājyeḍāmārjanānte ulūkhale musala ityeva hutvā dhruvāmāpyāyya prāyaścittāni juhoti na vā| athāgnīṣomīya ityata ārabhya etadantaṃ karma agnīṣomīyapaśuriti gīyate| hṛdayaśūlaṃ prakṣālya sthāpayitvā sampreṣyati| vyapakrāmataṃ mā vo'bhipariṣam | iti | ayaṃ bahirvedibhavanapraiṣa ucyate | tataḥ sarvai bahirvedi bhavanti | vasatīvarīrādāya gārhapatyasya paścānmārgeṇa nītvā dakṣiṇayā dvāropaniṣkra śrautapadārthanirvacanam | mya savyeṃse nidhāya dakṣiṇena mārjālīyaṃ sadaśca paryāhṛtyodaṅmukho dakṣiṇato yūpena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati indrāgniyorbhāgatheyī stha | iti punarādāyodaṅṅāvṛtya dakṣiṇeṃse nidhāya yathetametya śālāmukhīyasya paścātsaṃsṛṣṭā sādayati mitrāvaruṇayorbhāgadheyī stha iti | punarādāya dakṣiṇeṃse nidhāya pūrvayā dvāropaniṣkramya uttareṇa sada āgnīyaṃ ca parītyottarato yūpena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha| iti punarādāya pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya savyeṃse nidhāya punastenaiva mārgeṇāgatyāgnīdhrīyasya niṣṇayasya paścātsaṃsṛṣṭāḥ sādayati | yajñe jāgṛta | iti | idaṃ vasatīvarīsthāpanamucyate| atha sampreṣyati | yā samrāḍ dhuk tasyai dadhi gharmāya dadhi kuruta yā yajamānasya tasyā āmikṣāyai yā patnyai tasyā āśirepayaśca saktūṃśca kuruta śṛtātaṅkyamādityagrahāya dadhi kuruta puroḍāśīyāni piṣṭāni kuruta dhānā hāriyojanīḥ kuruta caturombhraṇāṃstrīnudañcanānayuja ekadhanāṃstryavamānekādaśa paramān dve raśane dve vapāśrapaṇyau ekatayamidhmābarhiraudumbarānmahāparidhīn kuruta subrahmaṇyāmāhvayatu | iti | ayaṃ sutyāsāmagrīsampādanapraiṣa ucyate| adhvaryu puruṣeṣvanyatamaḥ savanīyātiriktānāṃ śākhānāṃ krameṇa parṇāni chitvā agreṇa śālāmukhīyaṃ nidhāya mūlataḥ parivāsyopaveṣān kṛtvā śālāmukhīyasya paścāt prajñātānnidhāya dvitīyamantyaṃ ca śākhāpavitraṃ mantreṇa prākṛtena kṛtvānyāni ṣaṭ śākhāpavitrāṇi tūṣṇīṃ kṛtvā gārhapatyāduttarataḥ ṣaṭ dohanāni ṣaṭ śākhāpavitrāṇyaṣṭau sthālīśca sādayitvā prākṛtamantreṇa prokṣya tattadupaveṣeṇāṅgārānnirūhya tattatpavitra nidhāya tena tena dohanena dohayitvā taptvā
